notes.title: ⚖️ Presumption of Innocence at the Hotel
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/ed9ce4a3601a87fd45fe8d2c515927281ef0c33f.png"][/img][/p][p]Well, congratulations, you've survived your first day! The wolf didn't manage to eat you for dinner, and you're already a master at juggling trays and can comb a spa client's hair so well that she glows with pleasure. Neat![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]But it's too early to celebrate because a new guest arrives at the Hotel in the morning... [b]Her skin is whiter than snow, her fangs are sharper than blades, and her gaze is so fierce that your only thought is to run away.[/b] But no, she's not planning on drinking blood. It's much more [i]exciting[/i] than that. Handcuffs peek out of the pocket of her tight-fitting uniform. And it seems like she's looking right at you! Yes, yes, so intently that even the walls in the lobby blush.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/80fabf38e86417c4697dd03dbee9eb502d415ced.png"][/img][/p][p]Who is this mysterious beauty looking for? Does the presumption of innocence apply here? [b]Or is there some kind of thorough interrogation waiting for you?[/b] Alas, whatever it is, you can't relax: you still have to feed, water, and entertain your guests! Otherwise, they'll devour you faster than you can apologise.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/9883f48c2effc8cfe2022b46cf176fe41059ad88.png"][/img][/p][p]So get ready — a new day at the Hotel promises to be hot! [b]Add Hotel Tales to your wish list and decide for yourself: will you be a victim, a witness... or an accomplice?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hotel Tales hit 30k Wishlists!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/1ab06bab765320233f06278a4d36b12ce8af6fc9.png"][/img][/p][h3]The streak of surprises continues: we’re thrilled to announce that Hotel Tales has surpassed 30,000 wishlists! A huge thanks to all of you for your support and attention to the project![/h3][p][/p][p]We’re already hard at work on the bonus packs and community items unlocked through wishlist milestones. We’ve got plenty of exciting ideas for these rewards, and we’re sure you share our enthusiasm.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/d0eb1e024746cb43b54f1fba5f74f0563160eaba.png"][/img][/p][p]This game is a very special project for us. It has gone through many stages: countless mechanics were designed, reworked, and ultimately left behind as we searched for the perfect fit. Guests came and went, checking out with promises to return, while new ones took their place. Now we’re close to release, and the final result is the fruit of tremendous effort put into realizing our vision of Hotel Tales.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re more confident than ever and racing toward launch. Very soon we’ll share the exact release date, and believe us — we’re just as eager as you are. So start booking your rooms and clearing your weekends now![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Threat or passion? ❤️
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/ee6f61cba4d97ccc148bf6061b07510ad5474c0d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]You thought your shift would be quiet? Huh! It doesn't work like this at our Hotel[/b] 🌙[/h3][p]Just a moment ago, the hardest thing in your life was not dropping a handful of coins at the gas station. And look at you now: forced to play by the rules of the capricious and mysterious “[b]Mistress[/b]” of this Hotel — where, as everyone keeps warning, bad service might just get you eaten alive…[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]So you try to keep your head down and work, not tempt fate. But it’s getting harder to focus on the shaker when the [b]ghost girl behind the bar[/b] refuses to button up her shirt, and the [b]playful bellgirl[/b] can’t help but bend over in the most distracting way possible![/p][p][/p][p]The job was messy enough already, so of course fate tosses in a new challenge: a mysterious guest in a red cloak shows up at the Hotel doors. “The Beast is coming,” says the Mistress. “More trouble for us,” adds the vampire administrator.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/4b391aa5d307c247538297a16115bab5a5fdcb88.png"][/img][/p][p]What nobody mentioned: it’s not a [i]guest[/i] but a [i]lady guest [/i]— and she looks straight out of [i]Little Red Riding Hood[/i]. Except… what’s with the pistols and knives? And what is she looking for in the Hotel? Is she really “the Beast” bringing nothing but problems? Or can you unlock her fiery, tempting side? 😏[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/c6628cdc7fac0eb53d6d2680d98246fdfdcc85a9.png"][/img][/p][p]In this magical Hotel sim, every choice you make matters: shape the ending you want for each guest! But tread carefully, things are more than meet the eye![/p][p][b]Add Hotel Tales to your wishlist[/b] 💌 and come find out how your meeting with the wolf lady in red will end. Or… do you think you’ll be strong enough to resist her? 😏[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Who are they? The four heroines of Hotel Tales 🔥
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/de021b6950aa8cd5a9fa8666c9b489d2a664155f.png"][/img][/p][h3]✨ Hey there Hotel workers! ✨[/h3][p]Our Hotel is full of secrets, but there are also... some really hot babes.[/p][p]Lavo, the ghost bartender, will serve you more than just cocktails, but also a couple of hot secrets. Nikki is a rebel with a crown and a ponytail who will definitely never let you get bored. Pasiphea is like a ray of sunshine in the sea foam. And Pino... well, a doll with character will always find a way to surprise you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]But the question is still up in the air: Who will you give your heart to? 💕[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/197b98148eaeb3833b1af41dccbcf27e437cc54e.png"][/img][/p][p]She serves not only cocktails but also heated conversations. Perhaps she has died, and you are more alive than ever, but... opposites do attract, don't they?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/2a8376064924e6d7e0ec8848543cacd70c4d963b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Royal blood, a girl from the palace, who suddenly has a rather non-decorative tail![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/620c7aa8fc931a11923c5bb8d39197bb8c9e68f7.png"][/img][/p][p]She will always greet you with a warm sunny smile and send you off with kind words. Her voice is the whisper of the surf, her gaze a ray of light underwater.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/d6ecd6754efd59349affcbbe87ed1fa7a10b5b8d.png"][/img][/p][p]Pinocchio, but in a skirt, or rather, in a maid's outfit. And with an inner conflict. Claims she can't feel emotions. Or is the problem deeper?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tell us in the comments which of the girls has captured your heart the most![/b] ❤️‍🔥[/p][p]And don’t forget to add Hotel Tales to your wishlist — [i]the doors will be opening for you very soon…[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🔔 Жизнь в Отеле не стоит на месте!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/2ad81b638a55215fc1332fc3c2f7e71622751aa4.png"][/img][/p][p]👋 Hello, Hotel Keepers! 👋[/p][p]Today we are bringing you a little secret: at our Hotel Tales, the staff are not just decorations—they are alive (well... more or less).[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Every character has their own little life. The doll girl Pino? Right now she might be busy in the laundry room, and in one minute she'll be sweeping dust down the hallway with a broom.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/d93380b098e517a6094954f07dcef76856759d2b.png"][/img][/p][p]Veorr? He works in the kitchen, but, damn, try finding him when you urgently need a sandwich for a hungry guest! 🍖[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/72f65a8fe6da4c87b7934e915295e26d59011309.png"][/img][/p][p]Don't try to find employees in the same place. They're not statues! Everyone has their own schedule, their own habits, their own problems. Some have gone for a smoke break, some are pretending to be busy, and some are rushing around the hotel like Pasiphae at rush hour 🐠[/p][h3]🎮 What does this mean for you?[/h3][p]If you have a quest with a specific employee, you'll have to [b]play hide and seek[/b]. And this isn't a bug, it's a feature: we want you to feel the atmosphere of a “living hotel” at every turn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45497050/c9f70205ab9410e8ced5276366f957060abe85e5.png"][/img][/p][h3]💡 Little tip[/h3][p]Keep routes in mind and observe where characters like to hang out at different times of the day. This will save you both nerves and life (sometimes literally).[/p][p][/p][h3]🕯 What's new?[/h3][p]Development is in full swing, and we've added some fresh screenshots to Steam. Have you seen them yet? And the best part is that news and secrets about Hotel Tales will appear more often now, so [b]add our game to your wishlist[/b] and subscribe to our updates, and meanwhile we'll get back to searching for Veorr. Rumor has it that he's disappeared again...[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45497050/b086effc893034f14ce21f9cc61c306f61502012.png[/img]

[h3][b]🧜‍♀️ Hey, newbie! I don't think we've met? That's okay, let’s introduce ourselves! 🧜‍♀️[/b][/h3]

My name is Parsithea - I'm the hostess at the Crossroads Hotel and its charming face. [i]But first and foremost, of course, a hostess! [/i]Today I'm going to tell you about what has changed at our hotel since your last visit. Get ready, it's about to get interesting! 💋

[h3]You can join the hotel staff HERE 👇 👇[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45497050/456f03211266b1fd64b7128a2ad03ba5b197a686.png[/img]

Hotel Tales’ development doesn't stop for a second: new mini-games, backgrounds and characters are in the works, and the Hotel universe is growing fresh lore every day. But that's not all - another demo is in the active stage of development, where a new heroine - [b]Parsithea[/b] - is waiting for you, as well as some cool art! 🔥🔥🔥

[b]A little bit of information about the new heroine: [/b]

Once upon a time, Parsithea fell in love with a handsome prince and decided to trade her tail for a pair of shapely legs to please him. The romance lasted a week and after that the prince married the princess, leaving Parsithea alone. The spell that gave her legs begins to wear off over time, so Parsithea looks more and more like a mermaid every day. However, the more she resembles a mermaid, the better she sings.

notes.title: Our New VN with Monster girls and Armed agents! Add to your wishlist!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/25e7f6b000e39c45c0e64ce47670cbf895a215f5.png[/img]

[h3][b]💚 Welcome! On today’s menu, we have Sorrel coffee and… Sorrel Coffee! 💚[/b][/h3]
[i][b]"I drink Sorrel Coffee to reboot reality, but I'm being hunted by Monster Girls and armed agents” — seems like you know a lot about the game from the title? No? Then we’ll tell you! 🦎[/b][/i]

notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/0952feb59610365b79d5f3b67389f17fe91cc3f7.png[/img]

[b]✨ Welcome to the Hotel, dear guest! ✨[/b]

Come inside the foyer, have a seat. Don’t feel rushed, you’re right where you need to be. And while you’re waiting for the bellboy, I’ll tell you what resides inside the Hotel’s walls. Are you intrigued?

[i][b]Just click one button, and your journey will begin right now.

You won’t refuse the Hotel’s owner, right?[/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/efbe621786b974af084709391d27ea942dee9344.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/ac400d89c3e08f4b29618d65f3c3b0002d984ce5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/53523d2e84debb66f4f7f2bee15f5d7bb4143071.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/ec0f2e3c0bdae257d7ebba1a8187d18ab0a288a7.jpg[/img]

[i][b]Hotel Tales [/b]is a work simulator where you play as an employee of a hotel on the crossing of worlds. Dive into breathtaking, chilling and amusing stories of your guests and colleagues, uncover the Hotel’s mysteries and try to make it until your probation ends![/i]

[b]🗝 Work in the Hotel[/b]

- Check-in: choose an appropriate room, accounting the guest’s wishes and likes.
- Room service: deliver food, go on errands and help with the guest’s everyday problems.
- Conflict resolution: solve complex situations between guests or colleagues - this will affect your relationship with them.

[b]🗝 Interactive Elements[/b]

- Guests: their tasks will vary, from cooking unique recipes (such as potions) to helping find lost things (or guests!) in their rooms.
- Kicking back: you can have dinner with your guests and employees, have weekends to go on adventures with friends, engage in photography or collect stickers.

[b]🗝 Social Interactions[/b]

- Relationships with colleagues: these can vary from friendly to romantic. Every character has their story and approach. How they develop is entirely up to you!
- Your choices made during the workday will impact not only the immediate environment, but the game’s ending.

[b]🗝 Endings[/b]

- The ending depends on how good you performed your duties, who you developed a relationship with and what key choices you’ve made.
- Replayability: romantic endings, Hotel’s mysteries unraveling or even leading to it’s destruction (if things go horribly wrong). Collect them all!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/13b7339a45fde1c6d5ac398dae28b26b5e36e7fa.png[/img]

[i][b]Join the Hotel’s staff and become something more than a guest! You just have to wishlist Hotel Tales on Steam. We’ll wait for your first shift with great anticipation![/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413800/Hotel_Tales/
